name: ui
description: With this plugin you can add UI components from the neko-ui library to your react-native project.
author: nekoman-hq

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize UI plugin in the current project

flags.name: components-path
flags.description: Relative path where UI components will be stored (e.g., shared/ui)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available UI components from GitHub and show installation status

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add UI component(s) from GitHub to your project. Usage: neko ui add <component-name> or neko ui add --all

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove UI component(s) from your project. Usage: neko ui remove <component-name> or neko ui remove --all
